office_does: The PUD commissioners govern Wahkiakum County's county-wide public utility district; each is nominated in a district and elected by all PUD voters.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Gene Healy, elected unopposed in 2020, is the only candidate for a six-year term.

candidates.summary: PUD No. 1 Commissioner #1 since at least 2020; the only candidate.
highlights: Elected unopposed in 2020 with 98.04% of the vote [S3]
